title: Variables
summary: Variables are like labeled boxes where you can store information to use later. In programming, they hold data like numbers, text, or lists. You give them a name so you can refer to that data whenever you need it.
sample_question: Can you explain what a variable is in your own words, and give an example of why you'd use one?

title: Loops
summary: Loops allow you to repeat a block of code multiple times without writing it out over and over. For example, if you wanted to print 'Hello' 10 times, you'd use a loop instead of writing the print statement 10 times.
sample_question: What is the main advantage of using a loop, and can you describe a real-life situation that acts like a loop?
